english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something appealing or enticing, such as an offer.
This is the all-purpose choice for something that is captivating or very interesting.
Use this for a product, idea, or design that is appealing and exciting rather than sexually attractive.

examples.english: The design of this new packaging is really sexy and makes you want to buy it at first sight.
